about: Label amendments to eval/heldout_r2.json, written on 16 Nov 2026 AFTER its first runs. The sealed set is not edited (its checksum is quoted in every run log); the scorer applies these on top and reports the result with and without them. Each one makes a label stricter, never kinder. Reason: reading the cards of the first runs, the scorer passed cards we judge wrong, because the labels only forbade what we had thought of in advance.

52.why: "Where do you want to eat your dinner?" asks for a place. The first runs offered the About-me foods and passed.

57.why: "What music shall I put on?" asks for music. The first runs offered a TV show or a sports team next to Johnny Cash and passed.
